title: The presidential cycle: the strong stretch is midterm to the end of the pre-election year; buying at the start of the post-election year is one of the cycle's weakest 22-month holds
strategy: none — calendar windows of the US presidential cycle
question: Does the US presidential four-year cycle time the S&P 500, TAIEX, 0050 and TSMC — in particular buying at the start of the post-election year and selling after the midterm, and what does being out from March of the pre-election year cost?
hypothesis: Recalled timing: buy at the start of Y1, sell after the Y2 midterm. Common version: buy after the midterm, hold through Y3.

findings.title: Midterm to the end of the pre-election year is the strong stretch (S&P 500)
findings.detail: Exact post-midterm windows: 18 of 18 up, mean +19.31% (resolvable against zero 7.75). The month-start placebo (14-month holds from the 1st of each of 48 cycle months) puts the 1 November start 2nd of 48 (94.4% up, mean +20.34%, +9.57 points above the others against an optimistic bound of 7.92); the 1 October start ranks 1st. The pre-election year alone: 16 of 18 up, mean +17.22%.
findings.title_zh: 期中選舉後到選前一年年底最強（標普 500）
findings.detail_zh: 實際期中選舉後視窗：18 次全部上漲，平均 +19.31%。以每月 1 日起跑的對照：11 月 1 日起跑在 48 個月中排第 2（94.4% 上漲，平均 +20.34%，高出其他 9.57 個百分點，門檻 7.92），10 月 1 日排第 1。選前一年單年：16/18 上漲，平均 +17.22%。

findings.title: The recalled timing is near the cycle's worst
findings.detail: First close of Y1 to after the midterm: mean +9.42%, 72.2% up (n=18), but as a 22-month hold it ranks 47th of 48 starting months; −9.18 points below the others (resolvable 16.19, so not separable).
findings.title_zh: 「選後第一年買、期中選舉後賣」幾乎是最差時機
findings.detail_zh: 平均 +9.42%，72.2% 上漲（n=18），但在 48 個起跑月份中排第 47；比其他低 9.18 個百分點（門檻 16.19，無法分辨）。

findings.title: Out from March of the pre-election year has usually cost money
findings.detail: S&P 500 from 19 March Y3 to the next Y1: up in 15 of 18 cycles, mean +18.18%. TAIEX 3 of 7 (median −4.76%), TSMC 5 of 7 (mean +41.5%), 0050 3 of 3 since 2014.
findings.title_zh: 選前一年 3 月出場，通常是少賺
findings.detail_zh: 標普從選前一年 3 月 19 日到下一個選後第一年：18 次中 15 次上漲，平均 +18.18%。加權 3/7（中位數 −4.76%），台積電 5/7（平均 +41.5%），0050 自 2014 年 3/3。

findings.title: Taiwan: the midterm year is weak on TAIEX and 0050, flat on TSMC
findings.detail: Y2 (midterm year): TAIEX mean −5.04%, 3 of 7 up; 0050 −13.08% (n=2); TSMC mean −0.26% but median +8.79%, 4 of 6 up. Midterm → Y3 end: TAIEX 5 of 7, TSMC 6 of 6. Samples of 2–7 cycles: direction only.
findings.title_zh: 台股：期中選舉年加權和 0050 偏弱，台積電持平
findings.detail_zh: 期中選舉年：加權平均 −5.04%，7 次中 3 次上漲；0050 −13.08%（n=2）；台積電平均 −0.26%、中位數 +8.79%、6 次中 4 次上漲。期中選舉後到選前一年年底：加權 5/7、台積電 6/6。樣本 2–7 個，只看方向。

card_summary: On the S&P 500 (18 cycles) the strong stretch of the presidential cycle runs from the midterm election to the end of the pre-election year (18 of 18 up, +19.3% mean). Buying at the start of the post-election year and selling after the midterm is one of the weakest 22-month holds in the cycle. Taiwan has 2–7 cycles; TAIEX and 0050 are weak in the midterm year, TSMC is flat.
title_zh: 美國總統週期：最強的一段是期中選舉後到選前一年年底；選後第一年年初買進是週期裡最弱的 22 個月持有之一
question_zh: 跟著美國總統大選四年週期進出（選後第一年買、期中選舉後賣，或期中選舉後買、抱到選前一年），對美股、加權指數、0050 和台積電有沒有用？
hypothesis_zh: 選後第一年買進、期中選舉後賣出的報酬最好。
card_summary_zh: 標普 500 的 18 個週期中，期中選舉後到選前一年年底 18 次全部上漲、平均 +19.3%。選後第一年年初買、期中選舉後賣，是週期中最弱的 22 個月持有之一。台股只有 2–7 個週期：加權與 0050 的期中選舉年偏弱，台積電持平。
limitations_zh: 標普 18 個週期；加權 7、台積電 6–7、0050 2–3（Yahoo 的 0050 在 2014 年前資料有誤）。
標普與加權為價格指數，不含股息；現金報酬 0%。
48 個起跑月份的視窗互相重疊，門檻偏樂觀。
18 個觀測值的日曆規律只是 1953–2024 的描述，不是機制；台灣有自己的選舉和半導體週期。
interpretation_zh: 美股的總統週期裡，期中選舉後到選前一年年底是最強的一段，18 個週期全部上漲；常被記成「選後第一年買、期中選舉後賣」的版本反而接近最差的起點。台股只有 2–7 個週期，加權和 0050 的期中選舉年偏弱、台積電持平，只能當背景，不能當進出訊號。
